name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
description: A Central Government income support scheme for eligible landholding farmer families.
benefits: Eligible farmer families receive ₹6,000 per year.
The amount is transferred directly to beneficiary bank accounts in three equal installments.
eligibility: The applicant should belong to an eligible landholding farmer family.
The family must not fall under the scheme's exclusion categories.
important_conditions: Certain government employees, income-tax payers, institutional landholders and specified professionals are excluded.
eKYC is mandatory for registered beneficiaries.
Final eligibility is determined under official scheme guidelines by the relevant authorities.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: A Government of India health assurance scheme providing eligible beneficiaries with cashless hospital treatment.
benefits: Eligible beneficiaries receive health coverage up to ₹5 lakh per family per year.
Treatment is available at empanelled hospitals.
Eligible senior citizens aged 70 years or above can receive coverage regardless of economic status.
eligibility: Eligible families identified under the scheme's beneficiary criteria.
All senior citizens aged 70 years or above are eligible under the senior citizen expansion.
important_conditions: Eligibility and enrolment should be verified through the official portal.
Treatment must be covered under the scheme and provided at an empanelled hospital.
Aadhaar-based eKYC is required for enrolment of eligible senior citizens aged 70 or above.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
description: A Government of India scheme providing deposit-free LPG connections to eligible adult women from poor households.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection for eligible applicants.
The scheme provides assistance towards the connection.
Eligible beneficiaries receive the first refill and stove as specified under scheme provisions.
eligibility: The applicant must be a woman aged 18 years or above.
The applicant must belong to an eligible poor household.
There must be no existing LPG connection in the household.
important_conditions: A prescribed deprivation declaration and required documents must be submitted.
The final application is subject to official verification.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
description: A financial inclusion scheme that provides access to basic banking services.
benefits: Basic savings bank account without a minimum balance requirement.
RuPay debit card with applicable accident insurance cover.
Eligible account holders may receive an overdraft facility subject to conditions.
eligibility: Individuals who do not have a bank account can open a basic account.
Overdraft and insurance benefits are subject to scheme and account conditions.
important_conditions: Insurance coverage depends on applicable RuPay card conditions.
Overdraft is not automatic and requires eligibility verification.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
description: A rural employment guarantee programme providing wage employment to rural households.
benefits: Provides a guarantee of up to 100 days of wage employment per financial year to eligible rural households.
Supports rural livelihood security through unskilled manual work.
eligibility: The household must be in a rural area.
Adult household members willing to undertake unskilled manual work can register.
important_conditions: A Job Card is required.
Employment is provided according to the scheme process and applicable rules.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana Gramin
description: A rural housing scheme aimed at providing assistance to eligible rural households for construction of pucca houses.
benefits: Financial assistance for construction of an eligible rural house.
Convergence with other eligible government facilities may be available.
eligibility: Eligible rural households identified under the applicable selection and verification process.
Households must satisfy the scheme's housing deprivation and exclusion criteria.
important_conditions: Selection and assistance depend on official verification and applicable guidelines.
The beneficiary should verify their status with the Gram Panchayat or relevant authorities.

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
description: A scheme supporting traditional artisans and craftspeople who work with their hands and tools in specified traditional trades.
benefits: Recognition through a PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID card.
Skill training and toolkit incentive.
Access to collateral-free credit support subject to scheme conditions.
Marketing and digital transaction incentives as specified by the scheme.
eligibility: Artisans and craftspeople working in one of the 18 specified traditional trades.
Applicants must satisfy the scheme's age, registration and other eligibility conditions.
important_conditions: Only specified trades are covered.
Registration and verification through the prescribed process are required.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
description: A scheme providing working capital credit support to eligible street vendors.
benefits: Access to working capital loans under the scheme.
Incentives for eligible digital transactions.
Benefits for timely repayment according to scheme rules.
eligibility: Street vendors covered by the scheme's eligibility and identification requirements.
Applicants must complete the prescribed verification process.
important_conditions: Loan approval is subject to lender assessment and scheme rules.
Loan amounts and terms depend on the applicable scheme guidelines.

name: Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme
description: A credit-linked subsidy programme supporting eligible individuals in setting up new micro-enterprises in the non-farm sector.
benefits: Bank-linked financial assistance for eligible new enterprises.
Margin money subsidy according to applicant category and project location.
Support for self-employment and enterprise creation.
eligibility: Individuals above 18 years of age.
Only eligible new projects are considered.
Educational qualification requirements apply to projects above specified costs.
important_conditions: Existing units and units that have already received certain government subsidies are generally not eligible for new-unit assistance.
Bank approval and scheme verification are required.

name: National Scholarship Portal Schemes
description: The National Scholarship Portal provides access to multiple central and other scholarship schemes for eligible students.
benefits: Access to scholarship opportunities under participating schemes.
Financial assistance according to the specific scholarship's rules.
eligibility: Eligibility depends on the selected scholarship scheme.
Academic, income, category and institution requirements may apply.
important_conditions: Not every student qualifies for every scholarship.
Students should check the current academic year's application dates and eligibility on the portal.
